source: Static reading of https://js.rbxcdn.com/15d017a16565756ad25af08bc0a574244c4f6d5035a40b3ede8b5e47f9bd7415-CoreUtilities.js (served 2026-10-24; modules Roblox.core-scripts.auth.boundAuth / hba / sai / crypto) + live <meta name=hardware-backed-authentication-data> (see authlaunch-auth-www-page-meta.json)

key.storage: IndexedDB db=<data-hba-indexed-db-name>='hbaDB', store='hbaObjectStore', key='hba_keys', version=1 (roblox-bat README says db 'hbaStore' - live meta says 'hbaDB')

sai_at_login.nonce: GET https://apis.roblox.com/hba-service/v1/getServerNonce -> JSON string e.g. "QCD4CF44JQJDK4Y8" (works unauthenticated; x-ratelimit 50/60s)
sai_at_login.body_field: secureAuthenticationIntent: {clientPublicKey, clientEpochTimestamp (unix s, number), serverNonce, saiSignature}
sai_at_login.openapi: SecureAuthenticationIntentModel appears in auth v1/v2/v3 login, signup, 2SV-login, password change request models

bat_header.name: x-bound-auth-token
bat_header.bodyHash: base64(SHA-256(utf8(request body string)))  (GET/no body -> hash of empty string = 47DEQpj8HBSa+/TImW+5JCeuQeRkm5NMpJWZG3hSuFU=)
bat_header.attached_when: user authenticated AND host ends with .roblox.com/.robloxlabs.com/.roblox.qq.com AND data-is-bound-auth-token-enabled='true' AND IndexedDB names present AND a key pair exists
bat_header.client_side_host_whitelist_sampleRate: see meta: auth, gamejoin, games, users, friends, presence, thumbnails, economy, ... all at sampleRate 100

enforcement_failure_signature.web_behavior: CoreUtilities http client predicate IK(): 401 && errors[0].code===9002 && errors[0].subcode===2 -> onHbaUnauthorized -> dispatches DOM event 'rbx:hba-unauthorized'
enforcement_failure_signature.contrast: no cookie at all -> 401 {errors:[{code:9002,subcode:0,message:'Authentication token is missing'}]} (observed by curl)
